observations.title: Strong uptrend structure (7/7 trend-template checks)
observations.detail: Leaders in a Stage 2 uptrend typically meet all seven; stocks failing several are rarely where the strongest moves start.

observations.title: Extended: 24% above the 50-day average
observations.detail: Stocks stretched this far above their average often pull back or consolidate; buying here means a wider gap to the nearest support.

observations.title: New 52-week closing high on light volume (0.6x average)
observations.detail: Unconfirmed: breakouts usually need volume of at least 1.4x the 50-day average. Watch for follow-through or failure.

observations.title: Heavy-volume advance on 2026-10-15 (+3.0% on 1.5x volume)
observations.detail: Sharp gains on rising volume are a sign of institutional buying.

observations.title: RSI 77: overbought zone
observations.detail: In strong uptrends RSI can stay above 70 for weeks, so it is not a sell signal by itself; it does mean new buys are chasing strength.

observations.title: Relative-strength line at/near a 52-week high
observations.detail: The stock is outperforming the market (SPY) more than at any point in the past year; O'Neil looks for RS highs ahead of or alongside price highs.

levels.label: 52-week high
levels.note: A close above it on volume above 4.4M shares (1.4x the 50-day average) is the classic breakout confirmation.

levels.label: 2 x ATR below today's close
levels.note: ATR(14) is 2.83; two ATRs is a common volatility-based distance for judging noise vs a real move.

levels.label: 7-8% below today's close
levels.note: O'Neil's rule of thumb is to cut losses 7-8% below the purchase price. Shown from today's close (78.45 to 79.30) for scale only.

levels.label: 21-day average
levels.note: First support in strong uptrends; leaders often bounce here.

levels.label: 50-day average
levels.note: Key support for leaders; a close below on heavy volume is a warning.

levels.label: 200-day average
levels.note: Long-term trend line; losing it often marks the end of a Stage 2 uptrend.
